shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index gained 509 points or 0.98 percent on Friday to close at 52573 points.Gains were led by Cisco Systems (4.38%), IBM (3.89%) and Boeing (2.77%).Biggest losers were UnitedHealth (-2.47%), Amgen (-1.34%) and Merck (-0.47%).
